title: VETR: Execution-Grounded Self-Improving Agent for Symbolic Graphics Reasoning
title_zh: VETR：面向符号图形推理的执行驱动型自改进智能体

paragraphs.en: Visual agents for symbolic graphics reasoning depend on executable world representations, yet continued improvement remains bottlenecked by ambiguous supervision from final renders. Recent agentic systems refine scenes through repeated interaction, but they lack mechanisms to recursively extract actionable evidence from execution traces, overlooking which proposed symbolic edits survived, disappeared, or interfered during program execution. To address this, we propose VETR ( V erified E xecution T rajectories for R efinement), a framework that enables agentic recursive self-improvement over executable world representations for symbolic graphics reasoning. Within each task, VETR retains aligned program/render records with bounded runtime observations and introduces an execution refiner that compiles observed writes and state changes into constrained alternative programs. The refiner validates their endpoints and preservation conditions against captured runtime state; the ordinary visual verifier then assesses goal relevance. Repair construction makes no additional language-model calls, but can require additional executions. Evaluations on BlenderGym (280 tasks) and BlenderBench (27 released tasks) with GPT-5.6-luna and Qwen3.8-27B show that VETR consistently outperforms existing refinement strategies, including BlenderAlchemy and VIGA. Controlled ablations evaluate the contributions of execution refinement and role-asymmetric evidence organization under fixed generator-interaction caps.
paragraphs.zh: 用于符号图形推理的视觉智能体依赖可执行的世界表示，但其持续改进仍受最终渲染结果中模糊监督的制约。 近期的智能体系统通过重复交互来优化场景，但它们缺乏从执行轨迹中递归提取可用证据的机制，因而忽略了在程序执行过程中哪些拟定的符号编辑得以保留、消失或产生干扰。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 VETR（V erified E xecution T rajectories for R efinement），一个支持智能体对可执行世界表示进行递归自我改进的框架，专门用于符号图形推理。 在每个任务中，VETR 会保留与程序/渲染对齐的记录，并限制运行时观察范围，同时引入一个执行优化器，将观察到的写入操作和状态变化编译为受约束的替代程序。 该优化器会将这些程序的终点和保留条件与捕获的运行时状态进行验证；随后，常规的视觉验证器会评估其是否与目标相关。 修复构建过程不会额外调用语言模型，但可能需要执行额外的运行步骤。 在 BlenderGym（280 个任务）和 BlenderBench（27 个已发布任务）上，使用 GPT-5.6-luna 和 Qwen3.8-27B 进行的评估表明，VETR 的表现始终优于现有的优化策略，包括 BlenderAlchemy 和 VIGA。 受控的消融研究评估了在执行优化和角色非对称证据组织方面的贡献，同时控制了与生成器的交互上限。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have made remarkable strides in code generation, visual reasoning, and interactive editing by equipping LLMs with tools, planning, and self-refinement capabilities ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) . Building on this progress, recent systems for symbolic graphics reasoning formulate scene understanding and editing as an iterative process where a generator proposes program modifications and a verifier evaluates the rendered output ( Yin et al., 2026 ; Kuang et al., 2026 ) . These systems demonstrate that agentic interaction improves over one-shot generation and that executable programs can serve as world representations specifying geometry, materials, lighting, and spatial relationships ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . However, final-render feedback alone does not expose edit causality: an image comparison need not reveal which proposed symbolic edits survived execution, which were silently overwritten, or which interfered with shared scene resources.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过为 LLM 配备工具、规划和自我优化能力，在代码生成、视觉推理和交互式编辑方面取得了显著进展（Madaan 等人，2023；Shinn 等人，2023；Gou 等人，2024）。 基于这一进展，近期的符号图形推理系统将场景理解与编辑构建为一个迭代过程：生成器提出程序修改方案，验证器则评估渲染结果（Yin 等人，2026；Kuang 等人，2026）。 这些系统表明，智能体式交互相较于单次生成方法表现更优，且可执行程序能够作为世界表示，明确定义几何结构、材质、光照和空间关系（Wang 等人，2026a）。 然而，仅凭最终渲染结果无法揭示编辑的因果关系：图像对比未必能显示哪些提议的符号化编辑成功执行，哪些被静默覆盖，或哪些因共享场景资源而相互干扰。

Additional iterations can supply new proposals, but do not directly expose effects omitted from the feedback interface. We address this with supported update operators and explicit runtime preservation checks. Observed writes supply hypotheses about alternative executions, while visual verification remains responsible for assessing those alternatives against the task goal.

paragraphs.en: To address this, we propose VETR ( V erified E xecution T rajectories for R efinement), a framework for execution-grounded, within-task program refinement. VETR retains aligned executable records and uses a private execution refiner to construct alternatives from observed writes and state transitions. The refiner compiles supported numerical changes and compatible resource bindings, then checks their endpoints and preservation conditions by fresh execution, without additional language-model calls. It delivers a runtime-valid alternative when available, otherwise retaining the raw successful result or the preceding delivered record after failure. The ordinary visual verifier assesses the delivered result, and the generator conditions its next proposal on the available execution outcomes and feedback. This is the recursive program-revision loop depicted in Figure 1 ; Algorithms 1 and 2 specify its refiner and host loop.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 VETR（V erified E xecution T rajectories for R efinement），一个以执行为基础、用于任务内程序优化的框架。 VETR 保留对齐的可执行记录，并使用一个私有的执行优化器，从观察到的写入操作和状态转换中构建替代方案。 该优化器会编译支持的所有数值变更和兼容的资源绑定，然后通过新的执行检查其端点和保持条件，而无需额外的语言模型调用。 若有可用方案，它会提供一个运行时有效的替代方案；否则，在失败后保留原始成功结果或之前提供的记录。 普通的视觉验证器会评估所提供的结果，而生成器则根据可用的执行结果和反馈来调整其下一个提案的条件。 这就是图 1 中所示的递归程序修订循环；算法 1 和 2 分别定义了该循环的优化器和主循环。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate VETR on BlenderGym (280 editing tasks across five families) and BlenderBench (27 released tasks at three difficulty levels) with GPT-5.6-luna and Qwen3.8-27B. VETR is the strongest complete system on both benchmarks and both backbones, and paired comparisons confirm gains are not artifacts of completion rates. Ablations isolate the improvement to the execution refiner (disabling it reduces six-cell BlenderBench improvement from + 54.45 % +54.45\% to + 35.33 % +35.33\% on GPT and + 56.17 % +56.17\% to + 30.09 % +30.09\% on Qwen), and to role asymmetry and execution history (with GPT on BlenderGym, removing role asymmetry or limiting history raises N ​ - ​ C ​ L ​ I ​ P N\text{-}CLIP / P ​ L PL errors by 12.7%/23.7% and 48.5%/79.0%, respectively). These results support contributions from execution refinement and evidence organization within the evaluated agent loop; fixed generator-interaction caps do not imply equal total execution cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 GPT-5.6-luna 和 Qwen3.8-27B，在 BlenderGym（涵盖五个类别的 280 个编辑任务）和 BlenderBench（包含三个难度级别的 27 个已发布任务）上对 VETR 进行了评估。 在这两项基准测试和两种模型架构中，VETR 都是表现最强的完整系统；配对比较也证实了性能提升并非由完成率差异所导致。 消融实验表明，性能提升主要源于执行优化器（将其禁用后，在 GPT 上的六单元格 BlenderBench 任务改进幅度从 +54.45% 降至 +35.33%，在 Qwen 上则从 +56.17% 降至 +30.09%），以及角色非对称性和执行历史（在 GPT 于 BlenderGym 上的实验中，移除角色非对称性或限制执行历史会使 N-CLIP/PL 错误分别上升 12.7%/23.7% 和 48.5%/79.0%）。 这些结果支持了执行优化与证据组织在受评估的智能体循环中的贡献；固定的生成器交互上限并不意味着总执行成本相等。

paragraphs.en: VETR refines complete scene programs through a propose–execute–observe–verify loop. A private execution refiner constructs alternatives from bounded runtime observations and checks their realization before ordinary visual verification. Runtime acceptance and visual goal assessment serve different purposes: the former checks a candidate’s stated effects and preservation conditions; the latter guides subsequent editing toward the goal.
paragraphs.zh: VETR 通过“提出–执行–观察–验证”循环来完善完整场景程序。 一个私有执行优化器基于有限的运行时观察构建替代方案，并在常规视觉验证之前检查其实现情况。 运行时接受与视觉目标评估服务于不同目的：前者检验候选方案所声明的效果和保持条件；后者则引导后续编辑朝向目标推进。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the complete VETR system on two established test suites, BlenderGym ( Gu et al., 2025 ) and BlenderBench ( Yin et al., 2026 ) , which evaluate program-based 3D graphics editing across diverse visual modification tasks. Throughout the main benchmark results, VETR denotes the full system with execution refinement enabled by default; the otherwise matched variant with refinement disabled is reported only in the ablation study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个成熟的测试套件——BlenderGym（Gu et al., 2025）和 BlenderBench（Yin et al., 2026）上对完整的 VETR 系统进行了评估，这些测试套件用于评估基于程序的 3D 图形编辑能力，涵盖多种视觉修改任务。 在主要基准测试结果中，VETR 表示默认启用执行优化的完整系统；而其余条件相同但禁用优化的变体仅在消融研究中报告。

paragraphs.en: Tasks and systems. BlenderGym contains 280 editing tasks: 85 blend-shape, 50 placement, 55 geometry, 45 lighting, and 45 material tasks ( Gu et al., 2025 ) . Each task supplies an initial program, start image, and goal image. BlenderBench contains 27 released tasks across three difficulty levels, with nine tasks per level. We compare One-Shot (direct generation from the initial program and visual target without iterative feedback), BlenderAlchemy, VIGA, and VETR. GPT-5.6-luna uses three separate 280-task cohorts: systems, context ablations, and scene origin/guidance. All GPT-5.6-luna and Qwen3.8-27B runs use Blender 3.6.0, and every paired task shares a runtime. VIGA/VETR allow ten generator interactions. Each ablation changes only its named setting; system comparisons retain each system’s instructions and execution conventions. Table 16 maps these cohorts to the full results and configurations.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports the complete-system results. VETR achieves the strongest overall performance on both GPT-5.6-luna and Qwen3.8-27B, and consistently outperforms One-Shot, VIGA, and BlenderAlchemy across the aggregate metrics and nearly all family-level comparisons. On GPT, VETR attains the best P ​ L PL and N ​ - ​ C ​ L ​ I ​ P N\text{-}CLIP in four of the five editing families, with material editing as the only exception; on Qwen, it achieves the best result in every reported family–metric cell. These results are particularly notable in light of the original VIGA study ( Yin et al., 2026 ) , which reported substantial gains over a GPT-4o One-Shot baseline. In our experiments with newer and stronger backbones, however, the gap between iterative visual refinement and One-Shot becomes considerably smaller and can even reverse. A plausible explanation is that improvements in foundation-model capabilities have substantially strengthened one-shot program generation, reducing the headroom available to refinement strategies that rely primarily on rendered visual feedback. In contrast, VETR continues to improve substantially over these stronger One-Shot outputs. Rather than depending on an initially weak program that can be corrected through repeated visual inspection, VETR exploits execution evidence to identify which symbolic edits were actually realized, overwritten, or disrupted, and recursively incorporates this information into subsequent program states. These gains are statistically significant against One-Shot on both backbones: VETR lowers N ​ - ​ C ​ L ​ I ​ P N\text{-}CLIP / P ​ L PL by 52.7%/58.8% on GPT and by 28.1%/49.6% on Qwen, and on Qwen it also improves over VIGA by 40.0%/56.3%. In each case the bootstrap interval excludes zero and the sign test gives p ≤ .0043 p\leq.0043 (Appendix J , Table 11 ).

paragraphs.en: BlenderBench is a more demanding testbed than BlenderGym, with camera adjustment, multi-step editing, and compositional tasks that introduce stronger dependencies between successive scene modifications. These settings create more opportunities for intermediate errors to propagate, making them particularly suitable for evaluating whether VETR can preserve reliable refinement under increasingly entangled execution trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: BlenderBench 是一个比 BlenderGym 更具挑战性的测试平台，它包含相机调整、多步骤编辑以及构图任务，这些任务会在连续的场景修改之间引入更强的依赖关系。 这些设置创造了更多中间错误传播的机会，因此特别适合评估 VETR 是否能够在日益复杂的执行轨迹中保持可靠的优化效果。

paragraphs.en: The strongest separation appears on GPT Level 3, the most compositional setting, where VETR lowers N ​ - ​ C ​ L ​ I ​ P N\text{-}CLIP / P ​ L PL by 72.4%/75.2% relative to VIGA. This is precisely the regime in which execution-grounded refinement is most useful: when multiple edits interact, a failure may arise not only from an incorrect visual judgment but also from symbolic writes that are overwritten, only partially realized, or otherwise altered during execution. By retaining the execution trace and converting witnessed state changes into bounded program updates, VETR can correct these failures before they cascade into later steps. In contrast, render-only refinement has less direct evidence about which intermediate edits actually survived execution.

paragraphs.en: Disabling refinement degrades performance in 11 of the 12 level–metric cells across the two backbones (Table 4 ), often by substantial margins. On GPT, removing refinement increases both P ​ L PL and N ​ - ​ C ​ L ​ I ​ P N\text{-}CLIP errors at every difficulty level, with the largest degradation on Level 3: P ​ L PL rises from 5.3922 to 11.8475 and N ​ - ​ C ​ L ​ I ​ P N\text{-}CLIP from 6.3201 to 15.2108. The same pattern holds on Qwen, where disabling refinement substantially increases errors on Levels 1 and 3 and raises Level 2 P ​ L PL from 0.2585 to 2.9924. Paired statistics over the 27 GPT tasks confirm the effect: refinement lowers mean P ​ L PL by 41.8%, which is statistically significant (bootstrap interval [ 6.7 , 49.0 ] [6.7,49.0] excludes zero; sign test 24/3 wins, p = 4.9 × 10 − 5 p=4.9\times 10^{-5} ), and lowers mean N ​ - ​ C ​ L ​ I ​ P N\text{-}CLIP by 32.2% with a bootstrap interval of [ 14.4 , 55.5 ] [14.4,55.5] (Appendix J , Table 12 ).

paragraphs.en: VETR treats executions as evidence for revising an executable scene. Authoritative records identify the result being refined; observed writes and state transitions expose how proposed changes become realized effects. The refiner turns selected observations into executable updates by jointly choosing supported values and compatible bindings, then validates the resulting program against runtime contracts before visual verification. On native BlenderBench, adding this execution stage lowers aggregate visual error on both evaluated model backbones. Recorded interventions show how the same evidence-to-program pipeline operates inside ordinary visual reasoning, while the host-loop studies characterize the surrounding execution and context interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: VETR 将执行过程视为修订可执行场景的证据。 权威记录明确了正在优化的结果；观察到的写入操作和状态转换揭示了拟议变更如何转化为实际效果。 优化器通过联合选择受支持的值和兼容的绑定，将选定的观察结果转化为可执行的更新，随后在可视化验证前，依据运行时合同对生成的程序进行验证。 在原生 BlenderBench 上，添加这一执行阶段会降低两种评估模型主干上的总体视觉误差。 记录下来的干预过程展示了相同的“证据到程序”流程如何在常规视觉推理中运作，而主机循环研究则描述了周围执行环境与上下文接口的特征。

paragraphs.en: The BlenderGym history and execution-origin contrasts cover broad target-view editing; the native BlenderBench comparison evaluates the complete closed-loop refiner on released tasks. Runtime validation establishes realization and preservation only for the captured properties. Goal relevance is assessed by the ordinary visual verifier, allowing subsequent proposals to build on the delivered result. For another domain, such as SVG or CAD, the same principle requires observable program effects, supported update operators, and an explicit preservation contract. The current refiner operates on a fixed set of write types derived from the Blender execution model, so extending it to new domains requires defining additional write grammars and preservation boundaries. Future work could explore learned preservation models that infer coupling constraints directly from execution traces.

paragraphs.en: Programs provide compositional control over scene structure: LayoutGPT, 3D-GPT, Holodeck, and SceneCraft generate scenes via language models ( Feng et al., 2023 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2024 ) ; Scene Language unifies programs with semantic and visual representations ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) ; Code-as-World treats executable worlds as revisable hypotheses ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . NLI4VolVis combines language-guided editing with multi-agent control over editable 3D Gaussian representations ( Ai et al., 2026c ) , while end-to-end agent harnesses coordinate planning, implementation, and validation of visual analysis applications ( Miao et al., 2026 ) . For iterative editing, BlenderAlchemy, VIGA, and VULCAN combine rendered feedback, visual memory, and geometric constraints ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2026 ; Kuang et al., 2026 ) ; EZBlender adds local validation ( Wang et al., 2026b ) ; SEIG imposes stage budgets and rollback ( He et al., 2026 ) . These systems establish feedback loops but lack mechanisms to extract alternatives from execution traces. VETR fills this gap by compiling observed writes and bindings into bounded updates validated before the next proposal.
paragraphs.zh: 程序为场景结构提供了组合式控制：LayoutGPT、3D-GPT、Holodeck 和 SceneCraft 通过语言模型生成场景（Feng 等，2023；Sun 等，2025；Yang 等，2024；Hu 等，2024）；Scene Language 将程序与语义和视觉表示统一起来（Zhang 等，2025）；Code-as-World 将可执行世界视为可修订的假设（Wang 等，2026a）。 NLI4VolVis 将语言引导的编辑与对可编辑 3D 高斯表示的多智能体控制相结合（Ai 等，2026c），而端到端智能体则整合了视觉分析应用的坐标规划、实现和验证（Miao 等，2026）。 在迭代编辑方面，BlenderAlchemy、VIGA 和 VULCAN 结合了渲染反馈、视觉记忆和几何约束（Huang 等，2024；Yin 等，2026；Kuang 等，2026）；EZBlender 增加了局部验证（Wang 等，2026b）；SEIG 引入了阶段预算和回滚机制（He 等，2026）。 这些系统建立了反馈循环，但缺乏从执行痕迹中提取替代方案的方法。 VETR 通过将被观察到的写入和绑定编译为有界更新，并在下一次提案前进行验证，从而填补了这一空白。

paragraphs.en: Feedback-driven refinement is studied by Self-Refine, Reflexion, CRITIC ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) , Self-Debugging, and CodeAct ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) ; VDebugger leverages stepwise traces ( Wu et al., 2024 ) ; visual unit tests guide revision ( Panagopoulou et al., 2025 ) ; and agent-memory research examines experience reuse ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . HiLSVA combines feedback-driven adaptation with stepwise provenance ( Ai et al., 2026a ) , while SciVisAgentBench evaluates agent performance through task outcomes and multimodal assessment ( Ai et al., 2026b ) . Preservation is a complementary requirement: Prompt-to-Prompt, Plug-and-Play, and MasaCtrl maintain structure or appearance ( Hertz et al., 2023 ; Tumanyan et al., 2023 ; Cao et al., 2023 ) ; PIE-Bench, EditBench, MagicBrush, and ICE-Bench evaluate preservation alongside editing ( Ju et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Pan et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: SemFix uses symbolic execution for repair synthesis ( Nguyen et al., 2013 ) ; bidirectional evaluation propagates outputs backward through functional programs ( Mayer et al., 2018 ) . Unlike these methods targeting internal values, VETR derives candidates from witnessed imperative executions against an image objective, requiring no additional model inference. Separation logic and RustBelt motivate local state reasoning ( Reynolds, 2002 ; Jung et al., 2018 ) ; we instantiate this as finite runtime checks over captured properties. Graphics systems like Mitsuba 2 and OpenUSD provide the foundation of reusable, interacting scene resources ( Nimier-David et al., 2019 ; Pixar Animation Studios, 2023 ) , within which VETR performs recursive within-task program revision using execution-grounded evidence.
paragraphs.zh: SemFix 使用符号执行进行修复合成（Nguyen 等人，2013）；双向评估则通过功能程序反向传播输出（Mayer 等人，2018）。 与这些针对内部值的方法不同，VETR 从针对图像目标的所见指令式执行中推导出候选方案，无需额外的模型推理。 分离逻辑和 RustBelt 推动了局部状态推理（Reynolds，2002；Jung 等人，2018）；我们将其具体化为对捕获属性的有限运行时检查。 像 Mitsuba 2 和 OpenUSD 这样的图形系统为可重用且相互作用的场景资源提供了基础（Nimier-David 等人，2019；Pixar Animation Studios，2023），VETR 在其中利用基于执行的证据对任务内的程序进行递归修订。

paragraphs.en: The execution refiner converts bounded observations into constrained executable updates between raw execution and visual verification (Figure 2 ). It constructs candidate effects from earlier writes displaced during execution or effective changes between runtime states, then compiles them into parameter updates and permitted resource-ownership changes. The generator still proposes complete programs with its original prompt and tool schema. The refiner examines every submitted execution, including improving raw renders; planning actions do not invoke it. No additional language model identifies an error or constructs a repair.
paragraphs.zh: 执行精炼器将受限的观察结果转换为原始执行与视觉验证之间的受约束可执行更新（图2）。 它从执行过程中被移动的早期写入或运行时状态之间的有效变化中构建候选效应，然后将其编译为参数更新和允许的资源所有权变更。 生成器仍然使用其原始提示和工具模式提出完整的程序。 精炼器会检查所有提交的执行过程，包括改进原始渲染；规划动作不会调用它。 没有任何额外的语言模型能够识别错误或构建修复方案。

paragraphs.en: Here o i o_{i} is the owner bound at the executed statement, k i k_{i} a supported numerical property path, v i v_{i} its observed value, and ℓ i \ell_{i} its source location. Final numerical values, object-to-resource references, and captured structure reside in θ t \theta_{t} , Π t \Pi_{t} , and G t G_{t} , respectively. Resolving owners during execution distinguishes calls to the same submitted helper that write different objects. The observer covers supported assignments in submitted source, including local helpers; imported-library writes and unresolved aliases do not provide owner-qualified candidate evidence. A supported standalone assignment is read back at the next eligible Python trace event, observing application-level coercion without evaluating its right-hand side twice. paragraphs.en: The examples below characterize the archived program trajectories under the One-Shot prompt. On the 100 geometry and material tasks, the One-Shot runner and Blender 3.6 runtime are fixed. We characterize the observed editing behavior by the fraction of initial-program lines retained in the generated program (Appendix M , Table 15 ). paragraphs.en: The extended scorer reads the same stored final-answer images used for the primary metrics, matches render/goal filenames, and averages per-image values over available views and then over valid tasks. Images are loaded as RGB in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] at goal resolution; a size mismatch is resized to that resolution. PSNR is − 10 ​ log 10 ​ MSE -10\log_{10}\mathrm{MSE} in dB, with 100 dB used when MSE ≤ 10 − 10 \mathrm{MSE}\leq 10^{-10} . It is computed per image before averaging. SSIM uses skimage.metrics.structural_similarity , RGB channels, data_range=1 , and the default uniform 7 × 7 7\times 7 window. LPIPS uses the AlexNet backbone with the package's default learned calibration and inputs scaled to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . Edge F1 applies OpenCV Canny to both 8-bit grayscale images with thresholds ( 100,200 ) (100,200) . Each edge map is dilated by a 5 × 5 5\times 5 all-ones kernel: a match is within two pixels in Chebyshev distance. Precision is the fraction of predicted edges matched to a goal edge, and recall the converse; their harmonic mean is reported. Both maps empty gives 1; exactly one empty gives 0. CLIP is cosine similarity from ViT-B/32 image embeddings, equal to 1 − N ​ - ​ C ​ L ​ I ​ P 1-N\text{-}CLIP before the latter’s × 100 \times 100 table scaling. All CLIP tables derive it from the same canonical per-task N ​ - ​ C ​ L ​ I ​ P N\text{-}CLIP score, so their favorable orderings and ties agree exactly; separately recomputed cosine scores are retained in the scoring exports. For a higher-is-better metric, paired relative improvement is ( m ¯ first − m ¯ second ) / m ¯ second (\bar{m}_{\mathrm{first}}-\bar{m}_{\mathrm{second}})/\bar{m}_{\mathrm{second}} ; for LPIPS its sign is reversed. Reported percentages multiply these ratios by 100. Task-bootstrap CIs, wins, and sign tests follow Appendix J .
paragraphs.zh: 扩展评分器读取用于主要指标存储的最终答案图像，匹配渲染/目标文件名，并在可用视图中对每幅图像的值取平均，然后在有效任务中再次取平均。 图像以 [0, 1] 范围内的 RGB 格式按目标分辨率加载；若尺寸不匹配，则调整至该分辨率。 PSNR 以分贝（dB）为单位，计算公式为 −10 log₁₀ MSE；当 MSE ≤ 10⁻¹⁰ 时，取值为 100 dB。 该指标在取平均前按每幅图像单独计算。 SSIM 使用 skimage.metrics.structural_similarity，采用 RGB 通道、data_range=1 以及默认的均匀 7×7 窗口。 LPIPS 使用 AlexNet 主干网络，结合该包默认的已学习校准参数，并将输入缩放至 [−1, 1] 范围。 Edge F1 对两幅 8 位灰度图像应用 OpenCV Canny 边缘检测，阈值设为 (100, 200)。 每张边缘图通过一个 5×5 全一核进行膨胀：若切比雪夫距离在两个像素以内，则视为匹配。 精确率是预测边缘中与目标边缘匹配的比例，召回率则是其逆指标；报告的是两者的调和平均值。 两张地图均为空时结果为 1；仅其中一张为空时结果为 0。 CLIP 采用 ViT-B/32 图像嵌入的余弦相似度计算，在乘以 100 进行表格缩放前，其值为 1 − N-CLIP。 所有 CLIP 表格均基于同一标准任务级 N-CLIP 分数生成，因此其有利排序和并列情况完全一致；单独重新计算的余弦分数仍保留在评分导出文件中。 对于“越高越好”的指标，成对相对改进值为 (m̄_first − m̄_second)/m̄_second；对于 LPIPS，该值的符号会被反转。 报告的百分比是将这些比率乘以 100 得到的。 任务自助置信区间、获胜次数和符号检验遵循附录 J 的方法。

paragraphs.en: For this program-form analysis, each source line is truncated at its first # , whitespace is normalized, and empty lines are removed; thus inline comments are stripped. Retention counts initial-line occurrences whose normalized text appears anywhere in the generated program, divided by the initial line count. Changed lines counts initial-line occurrences absent from the generated program plus generated-line occurrences absent from the initial program. Identical means equality of the normalized line sequences. A program is scene-clearing if the source contains read_factory_settings , bpy.ops.object.delete , objects.remove( , or nodes.clear() . A program contains a 4.x binding if it names a Blender identifier introduced in 4.0–4.2 and absent in 3.6 ( BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT , surface_render_method , the Principled-BSDF sockets Specular IOR Level , Subsurface Weight , Subsurface Scale , Transmission Weight , Coat Weight , Coat Roughness , Sheen Weight , Emission Color , and the Noise-Texture socket Lacunarity ). The 100 geometry and material tasks are used because they are the tasks whose archived GPT One-Shot programs were produced and executed under Blender 3.6.
paragraphs.zh: 在此程序形式分析中，每行源代码会在其第一个 # 处截断，空白符会被规范化处理，空行则会被移除；因此，行内注释也会被剥离。 保留率是指初始行中那些经规范化后的文本在生成的程序中任意位置出现的次数，除以初始行的总数。 修改行数是指初始行中未出现在生成程序中的行数，加上生成程序中未出现在初始程序中的行数。 “相同”意味着规范化后的行序列完全一致。 如果源代码包含 read_factory_settings、bpy.ops.object.delete、objects.remove( 或 nodes.clear()，则该程序属于“场景清空”类型。 如果一个程序命名了 Blender 4.0–4.2 版本引入但在 3.6 版本中不存在标识符（如 BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT、surface_render_method、Principled-BSDF 接口的 Specular IOR Level、Subsurface Weight、Subsurface Scale、Transmission Weight、Coat Weight、Coat Roughness、Sheen Weight、Emission Color 以及 Noise-Texture 接口的 Lacunarity），则它包含一个 4.x 绑定。 之所以使用这 100 个几何与材质任务，是因为这些任务的存档 GPT One-Shot 程序是在 Blender 3.6 环境下生成并执行的。

paragraphs.en: Persistent execution yields one, three, and nine modifiers at steps 1, 3, and 9; the corresponding measured volumes are approximately 4, 1, and 0.015625 Blender units cubed. Rebuild and replacement both retain one modifier and volume 4 throughout. The evaluated meshes retain eight vertices and six faces under all policies: the effect here is repeated transformation, not growing mesh topology. Object bounds, modifier identities, script/base/helper hashes, and all 27 observations are supplied. paragraphs.en: The task supplies both blender_file.blend ( B B ) and start.py ( p 0 p_{0} ). The latter is the editable reference program shown to the generator; the runner does not execute it as an extra preparation step before a proposal. It loads the supplied native scene and executes the submitted script once. Thus, a complete proposal is complete relative to the assets and objects already supplied in B B . The answer rule in Appendix N associates the evaluated render with the program in its selected delivered record, which may be a repaired program rather than the submitted script. A cached fallback retains the provenance of its earlier render and does not assign that render to a failed submission.
paragraphs.zh: 该任务同时提供了 blender_file.blend（B B）和 start.py（p 0 p_{0}）。 后者是展示给生成器的可编辑参考程序；运行器不会在提案之前将其作为额外的准备步骤执行。 它会加载所提供的原始场景，并执行一次提交的脚本。 因此，一个完整的提案相对于 B B 中已提供的资产和对象而言是完整的。 附录 N 中的答案规则将评估后的渲染结果与所选交付记录中的程序关联起来，该程序可能是修复后的程序，而非提交的脚本。 缓存的备用方案会保留其先前渲染结果的来源信息，并且不会将该渲染结果分配给失败的提交。

paragraphs.en: agents/generator.py samples and executes candidate actions, selects a returned outcome, invokes the verifier when requested, appends the selected interaction, and logs all candidates. agents/prompt_builder.py pins the initial two messages and applies the role-specific recent-message window, with tool-boundary handling. The runner sets the generator window to three for the short-history variant, enables shared history for the role-asymmetry control, and bypasses verification for the no-verifier control. The complete-script response field and latest-render guidance are prompt instructions; the final-answer evaluator separately selects the last successful render. The N > 1 N{>}1 path votes over action types before executing candidates of the selected type; Algorithm 2 explicitly places refinement before the selection of delivered outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: agents/generator.py 会采样并执行候选动作，选择返回的结果，在需要时调用验证器，追加选定的交互过程，并记录所有候选项。agents/prompt_builder.py 会固定最初的两条消息，并应用针对特定角色的最近消息窗口机制，同时处理工具边界问题。 运行器将生成器的窗口大小设为三（用于短历史变体），为角色不对称控制启用共享历史，并在无验证器控制中跳过验证步骤。 完整脚本响应字段和最新渲染指导属于提示指令；最终答案评估器则单独选择最后一个成功渲染的结果。 在 N > 1 的 N{>}1 路径中，系统会先对动作类型进行投票，再执行所选类型的候选项；算法 2 明确将优化步骤置于交付结果的选择之前。

paragraphs.en: The released generator prompts combine shared evidence-use instructions, Blender binding/API conventions, and family-specific guidance. All context-window conditions share these instructions. The VIGA runner saves successful scene updates, whereas the VETR runner loads the task base scene for each complete-script execution. History and scene-origin contrasts change individual settings; the same-run prefix analysis holds initial guidance fixed, and role-prompt/recipe controls are reported in Appendix O .
paragraphs.zh: 已发布的生成器提示词结合了共享的证据使用说明、Blender 绑定/API 惯例以及特定于家族的指导方针。 所有上下文窗口条件都共享这些说明。 VIGA 运行器会保存成功的场景更新，而 VETR 运行器则会在每次完整脚本执行时加载任务基础场景。 历史记录和场景来源的差异会改变个别设置；同一运行中的前缀分析会保持初始指导方针不变，角色提示/配方控制则在附录 O 中说明。
